title: 2 Doors
description: Crafting doors now gives you 2 instead of 3!
body:
# 2 Doors

Ever noticed that crafting doors gives you 3, but you almost never need an odd number of doors? 
This small mod fixes that. Crafting any door now gives you **2** instead of 3.

## Features
- All 12 door types are supported:
  - Oak, Spruce, Birch, Jungle, Acacia, Dark Oak, Mangrove, Cherry, Bamboo, Crimson, Warped, and Iron
- No configuration needed, just install and play
- Lightweight, no impact on performance

## Installation
1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) for Minecraft 1.21.11
2. Download [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
3. Drop both `fabric-api` and `2-doors` into your `mods` folder
4. Launch Minecraft and enjoy!

## Compatibility
- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader 0.18.4+
- Fabric API required
